projectDescription: A marketplace connecting families and homeschoolers with credentialed, reviewed educators for live one-on-one and small-group sessions.
keyFeatures: Educator marketplace with search and filtering by subject, price, and credential tier
Four-tier credential ladder (Foundations → Proficiency → Mastery → Distinction) based on verified teaching hours
Multi-dimension session ratings: Appropriateness, Professionalism, Teaching Skill, Subject Knowledge
Transparent 15–20% platform fee deducted from educator payout, not added to families' cost
Live session booking with real-time availability and secure payment
Learner engagement tiers (Curious → Committed → Devoted → Scholar) tracking hours studied
Multiple payment methods: credit/debit card, ACH bank transfer, PayPal, Venmo
Automatic payouts to educators 1–2 business days after each completed session
Educator and learner dashboards with earnings, upcoming sessions, and progress tracking
Early-access waitlist with onboarding in waves
publicApiSurface: Browse/search educators by subject, category, price, and credential tier
View educator profile with credential tier, ratings, and reviews
Book a session (time slot selection, session details, payment)
Learner dashboard: upcoming sessions, saved educators, learning tier progress
Educator dashboard: earnings, hours logged, upcoming sessions, review breakdown
